protocol.selection: None. Three fixed comparisons; no promotion, tuning or winner selection from these assessment scores.
protocol.reservedScoring: Never scored or used for selection; no year-end evaluation in this experiment.

adaptiveScale.calibration: abs(actual-quarter-total-predicted-quarter-total)/scale at each original as-of calibration origin; labels visible by assessment origin

detector.use: Assessment issuance only. Calibrate all eleven allowed residuals; do not filter calibration folds by detector.
detector.interpretation: Fixed past-change heuristic; not a calibrated significance test or detector of an unobserved future change.

range.quantile: order statistic ceil((n+1)*0.9); all11 required; unavailable if rank exceeds n

evaluation.unit: One seeded history and one held-out quarter per family/group; comparisons paired on identical seeds.
evaluation.pairedSupport: Report common-issued scored seed count and coverage/width/interval-score differences versus baseline; no claim of independent method replications.
evaluation.intervalScore: width + 20*(lower-actual) if actual<lower, or width + 20*(actual-upper) if actual>upper, after clipping and rounding
evaluation.gate: Same strict full100 available/scored and empirical>=0.9 and Wilson95lower>=0.9; any abstention fails. Conditional coverage remains descriptive, not promotion.
evaluation.missingMetric: null, never zero or complete-case denominator substitution

protocol.custody: Old validation results are inspected diagnostic/development evidence. Freeze before any seed2001–2100 generation/scoring. New seeds are separate simulations of known families, not blinded scenarios or real-world observations.
protocol.failurePolicy: Report all methods, families, groups, seeds, missing folds and failures. Do not widen, retune, relabel or regenerate chosen seeds to pass.

generatorConfig.custody: Protocol committed before dataset generation or model evaluation; constructed holdouts are not independently blinded real-world validation.
generatorConfig.evaluation: This checkpoint generates, reconciles and replays aggregates only. No predictive performance, causal effect or calibrated interval is claimed.

limitations: New seeds assess fixed heuristics in the same visible scenario families; they are not new real data or unseen scenario validation.
A July change absent from June-available history cannot be anticipated by a past-change detector. No scenario label is a forecast feature.
Adaptive scales and three-sigma abstention are fixed heuristics, without exchangeability, calibrated detector significance or distribution-free coverage guarantees.
Conditional coverage excludes abstentions from its denominator; issuance-and-coverage rate and all100 denominators remain explicit.
All original monthly suppression and complete-history/calibration requirements remain; unavailable metrics are null.
Quarter-total intervals are evaluated after clipping/rounding. Paired methods share histories; groups and months are not independent replications.
All candidate bounds remain offline diagnostics. No published interval, original gate, production consumer or operational source qualification is changed.
